label: Unexpected roaming charge
ticket: My latest invoice includes a roaming add-on I do not recognize. My phone service works normally. Could someone explain this charge before I decide whether to dispute it?

label: Business connectivity outage
ticket: All 18 lines at our dispatch center lost connectivity 30 minutes ago. Calls and mobile data are down and dispatch operations have stopped. Please investigate urgently.

label: Change a mobile plan
ticket: I would like to switch my mobile plan to a larger data allowance next month. Please explain the available process and what information you need from me.

label: Single line without data
ticket: Mobile data has not worked on my phone since this morning. Voice calls still work and my colleagues have normal data service. Restarting the phone did not help.
